crossRefs.note: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but…
Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
